featureReviews.notes: Long five-board top on six square legs, two stretchers per side, an X brace at each end, the toothed blade standing through the top and the log in front of the blade's right half all sit where the reference has them (Tier-1 IoU 0.898 at the fitted camera az 31 / el 6 / fov 24, with the reference's floor shadow reproduced by the contact-shadow decal). The blade's lower half shows between the front-left and front-middle legs as in the reference.
20 hooked teeth read at the rim; no arbor hub yet (meso, structural-pass), so the blade centre is empty compared with the reference's dark boss.
Log lies on the top against the blade with the right length; no pale cut face yet (micro), its end reads as a dark octagon.

summary: Blockout matches the reference's macro silhouette at the fitted camera (az 31, el 6, fov 24): Tier-1 IoU 0.898, aspect delta 0.011, scale delta 0.0003; turntable complete with the bench's real openings allowed, no degenerate view, no self-intersection.
matched: long thick top on six square legs
front and back stretchers, X braces at both ends
large toothed blade through the top, lower half visible under it
log on the top in front of the blade's right half
mismatches: no arbor hub or nut yet (meso)
top reads as one slab: board seams and the blade slot are meso/micro
log end has no pale cut face yet (micro)
wood albedo too orange-red and streaky; blade too bright and bluish; log too red (material-pass)
specFixes: structural-pass: hub and nut at the blade centre, board seams and slot in the top
notes: Viewed renders/blockout/cmp.jpg (reference left, render right) and renders/blockout/turntable.jpg. The camera fit and the contact-shadow settings are recorded in renders/camera-fit/.
